info.description: Discover the Haus zum Wald in Bad Wörishofen – not a classic hotel, but your retreat for living, working, and relaxing. This is where award-winning design meets absolute clarity.
info.paragraph1: With us, you will find the perfect balance of productivity and relaxation. Our serviced apartments offer you high-quality, durable design and the freedom you need for short breaks or longer stays. A place where you can arrive and immediately take a deep breath.
info.paragraph2: Thanks to 24/7 contactless check-in, you can organize your day with complete flexibility. Use our modern coworking space with high-speed internet and flat-rate drinks, or explore the nature around the Wertach river and the cradle of Kneipp therapy.

blocks.text: Your home away from home in Bad Wörishofen

parts.value: I am Max-Josef Groß, Managing Director of Haus zum Wald. Since the beginning of our planning, it has been a matter truly close to my heart to create a place that consciously breaks with the rigid conventions of a classic hotel. My mission is to offer you real space to breathe and arrive, where minimalist design and thoughtful comfort seamlessly intertwine. It is a personal concern of mine to design an environment in which you feel secure from the very first moment and can concentrate entirely on the essentials.

blocks.alt: Max-Josef Groß – Managing Director in Bad Wörishofen

parts.value: At Haus zum Wald, you can feel the substance of a mature ensemble that we have completely rethought with a great love for clarity. We firmly believe that true relaxation lies in conscious reduction and not in loud distractions or overloaded service. That is why we dispense with the hustle and bustle and instead give you the peace to find your very own rhythm. Here you can simply arrive, stay, and enjoy the moment to the fullest without any pressure.

blocks.text: Living, working, and relaxing in harmony

parts.value: Experience the seamless connection of everyday life, work, and relaxation in our modern serviced apartments in Bad Wörishofen, which are ideal for short breaks or longer stays. For productive hours, our quiet coworking space in the Allgäu offers you not only high-speed internet but also an unlimited drinks package with high-quality coffee and tea. If you are planning special moments, our bright premises are available to you as an event space in Bad Wörishofen for workshops and celebrations in an intimate setting. A contactless check-in is set up around the clock for every apartment, so you can arrive completely independently of fixed times.

blocks.text: Who we created this place for

parts.value: Our concept is aimed at people who appreciate clarity and are looking for a conscious alternative to a classic hotel. Whether you are a business traveler planning an inspiring workation in Bavaria (the seamless combination of work and vacation), a design lover wanting to enjoy high-quality architecture, or a relaxation seeker needing a break, you will find your place here. We offer you the freedom of your own apartment, combined with thoughtful services that make living and working in the Allgäu noticeably easier.

blocks.text: Quality you can see and feel

parts.value: High-quality furnishings and durable materials create a calming, grounded atmosphere in each of our rooms. Our interior is characterized by the award-winning design of Variand, which was honored with the renowned German Design Award for its outstanding aesthetics. We consciously do without a classic reception, but are always there for you in the background. Our reliable availability around the clock via phone and WhatsApp gives you the secure feeling of being well looked after at all times.

blocks.text: Embedded in the nature of the Allgäu

parts.value: Your home away from home in Bad Wörishofen benefits from a unique environment that perfectly combines relaxation and experience. As the historical cradle of Kneipp therapy in Bad Wörishofen (a traditional hydrotherapy for health promotion), the region offers you wonderful opportunities to do something for your well-being, while the nearby river Wertach invites you to take long walks. You are also ideally connected for excursions, be it through the proximity to Bavaria's largest amusement park or the excellent accessibility via the A96 motorway, the local train station, and the Allgäu Airport.

Leave everyday life behind and discover a place that creates space for new thoughts and deep relaxation. Experience the special atmosphere of our apartments and find your very own rhythm in an environment that supports you. We look forward to welcoming you soon to Haus zum Wald, your stylish retreat for living and working in the Allgäu.
